text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate from okta-introspect-prod — token introspection failing (502/503) — 18% error rate over 5m. Graph: https://metrics.redwood/alerts/okta-introspect-1742509876

emma: Paging @raj (on-call) — seeing increased login failures in prod. root cause unknown, possibly Okta API. Can you triage? :rotating_light:

raj: On it. grabbing the Okta runbook and logs now. will post timeline and mitigation plan.

sophie: Seeing a mix: frontend flow gets `401 invalid_token` and our backend introspect calls respond 502/503 intermittently. Affects UI sign-in and API token revocation flows. Internal console logins also failing.

maria: Creating incident page and incident channel thread. Incident created INC-2026-0421 — https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0421. Notifying CSMs and support.

emma: Quick question: can we skip remote introspect and verify JWT locally (JWKS) as a fallback? That would avoid the introspect call spike.

raj: Trying that now. Steps: 1) increase JWKS cache TTL 5m -> 1h 2) enable `local_jwt_verification` feature-flag for session verification 3) route any failing introspect requests to cache-only path.

raj: Log snippet from prod (curl to Okta introspect):
```
$ curl -s -I https://okta-prod.example.com/oauth2/v1/introspect
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"server_error","error_description":"upstream connect error or disconnect"}
```

emma: TY. Note: local verification won't catch token revocations done via introspect — we'll need to revalidate once Okta is healthy. communicate that in customer update.

sophie: Customer impact tally: 8 paying customers reported sign-in errors, 3 enterprise customers report inability to access the console (admin UI). Internal SSO also impacted for some engineers. File numbers to post in status.

maria: Opened a support case with Okta: SR-84231. Okta on-call responded: "investigating partial regional network issues affecting introspect endpoints; will update." Contact: support@okta.example / oncall pager.

raj: Mitigation applied: JWKS cache TTL bumped to 1h and `local_jwt_verification` enabled in prod via feature-flag. Rolling restart of 5% of auth-proxy fleet to pick up flag.

raj: Metric update: introspect call failure rate dropped from 18% -> 3% within 4 minutes after local verification enabled. User login errors down by ~75%.

emma: Drafting customer status update: "We observed intermittent failures verifying sessions via our identity provider (Okta). We have applied a temporary fallback — local token verification — to reduce login failures while Okta investigates. We will revalidate tokens once their service is healthy. Next update in 30 minutes." Approve? @product-ops

product-ops: LGTM — please add suggested workaround for admins (clear browser cache + retry sign-in). Also mention affected regions if we confirm.

maria: Notifying impacted customers via support threads and status page. Logged list: acme-markets, neptune-ads, skylark-fin. (internal shorthand).

raj: Okta support updated SR-84231: "partial ingress outage in us-west-2 for introspect endpoint; mitigations in progress. No ETA yet." They asked for request IDs — posted sample x-request-id from logs.

emma: Good. We should also enable an automatic retry/backoff for introspect calls so we don't overload their endpoints while degraded. Add to post-incident actions.

sophie: Confirmed no signs of token compromise in audit logs so far; tokens failing verification appear due to upstream 5xx, not signature mismatch. Will continue log scan.

raj: Temporary routing note: for EU traffic we routed introspect -> okta-eu and it's stable. US regional traffic still seeing intermittent 502s. Implemented weighted routing during mitigation window.

maria: Customer comms posted on status.redwood.com: "We are operating under a temporary fallback verification. Customers may see transient sign-in errors; we are monitoring."

emma: Next steps: 1) keep JWKS cache & local verification for now, 2) coordinate with Okta until fully healthy, 3) schedule postmortem and remediation tasks (retry/backoff, safer fallback, post-incident audit).

raj: Adding immediate tasks to incident board: 
- Re-run token revocation check once introspect healthy
- Revert `local_jwt_verification` only after full Okta recovery and QA
- Add metrics alert for fallback enabled

jordan: Taking handoff for overnight coverage at 1742513476. Summary for handoff: fallback local verification enabled, Okta SR-84231 open, metrics show error rate ~3%, impacted customers notified, oncall page updated. Ping me if any regression.

emma: Handoff ack — @jordan please keep watch on login error rate and customer escalations. If Okta indicates resolution, coordinate a staged rollback and post-rollback validation.

jordan: Understood. Will run the warm-handoff checklist and post an update on recovery or rollback plan. :thumbsup:

maria: Post-incident reminders: ensure support threads include timeline, update billing/ticketing tags, and schedule postmortem meeting for tomorrow.

incident-bot: INC-2026-0421 status updated: Mitigation in place (local verification), Okta case SR-84231. Next automated check in 15m.

emma: Closing this thread for now. Will reopen if we see regression or Okta confirms root cause/resolution. Thanks all for fast response. :heart:
